results.graph: 2 junction clusters: A{270,271} (iliac-1 arm 251 mm + 1.5/2.1 mm loop stubs + 2.6 mm link) and B{272,276,277,279} (iliac-2 arm 264 mm, aorta arm 608 mm, 12.8 mm r=4.8 endpoint branch of 7 nodes, 2.1 mm link). Carina region ~15 mm wide, radii at B nodes at the 3.0 mm clamp, up to 8.6 mm at A.
results.anatomy: the 12.8 mm branch ends inside the iliac_artery_left TotalSegmentator label (0.7 mm); it is a lobe of the wide/irregular carina, not an independent anatomical vessel (B/C character), but no existing patient-independent rule removes it: loop collapse does not apply (it ends on an endpoint) and the 12 mm spur threshold is 0.8 mm below its length.
results.access_path_under_current_contract: none: iliac-1 entry sees a 2-arm cluster, iliac-2 entry a 4-arm cluster
results.other_patients: any rescue (spur threshold > 12.8 mm or a cluster-merge distance) would be a new rule; 14 of 69 patients have >1 junction cluster and 14 have endpoint arms <60 mm on a junction cluster (s1379 12.4 mm, s0477 14.6 mm, s0903 16.2 mm, s1348 16.5 mm), so it would alter other extractions and was not applied.
